full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for the disposal of the cases in reference arc that the opposite party No.2, being owner possessor of the lands described in the second schedule of the Misc. Case Nos.76 of 1983, 77 of 1983 and 82 of 1983, sold out the same through three separate registered sale deeds dated 26.8.1982, and the consideration for each of the sale was fixed at Tk.1,000/- each, and the sale took place beyond the knowledge of the petitioner and that the petitioner is a recorded tenant of Khatian No.66 in which the case plot belongs, and further the petitioner is also a co-sharer by purchase in the same khatian. The total land sold vide said three sale deeds was 0.80 acres. The petitioner came to know about the sales definitely after obtaining the certified copy of the sale deeds on 24.1.1983 and 13.1.1983. The plaintiff deposited Tk.1000/- for each case for pre-emption being the deed value plus the compensation, in terms of Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
